One shared frame retains O-A-B-C-D-E-K in increasing horizontal order. OA is a straight rise, AB and BC rise, CD is horizontal, DE rises to E, EK descends rightward to K above the axis and stops there. No extra continuation was added.

A/Q, E/unlabelled foot and K/P stay vertically aligned. Their foot order is O-Q-unlabelled-P. All three vertical and all three horizontal guides remain solid. The middle Elastic guide ends at B below CD, not at C.

E is the curve maximum and K the final point; the engineering-stress interpretation remains bound to the unchanged already-approved Chinese prose. No true-stress curve, unloading line, calibrated ticks, numerical coordinates or invented units are visible.

All visible words are ordinary English with allowed sigma/epsilon symbols and point letters. No Cyrillic or Chinese text is visible in the figure.
The current native PNG is byte-identical to the personally opened 640px SVG preview; it was not separately reopened.
